newsitem.title: USA: Audio King November same-store sales fell two pct.
newsitem.headline: Audio King November same-store sales fell two pct.

text.p: Audio King Corp said on Thursday its November same-store sales fell two percent compared to the year-ago period.
Sales for the month fell one percent to $5,975,000 from $6,041,000 in November 1995.

Year-to-date sales for the five months ended November 1996 were $26,981,000 compared to $26,883,000 for the same period last year. Year-to-date same-store sales fell two percent from the year-ago period, the company said.
"Our Thanksgiving weekend business, two days of which fell in November, was very strong," said Gary Thorne, Audio King's president and chief executive officer, in a news release.
Audio King operates eleven consumer specialty electronics products retail stores.
